title: Experimental structured line response from a model
description: Never a default coordinate source. A response is only accepted after cross-validation against the locally measured page; see docs/ocr-providers.md.

bbox.description: [x, y, width, height] in the page's pixel coordinate system, origin top-left. A response in any other system fails the in-page gate rather than being rescaled: silently rescaling a wrong guess produces a confident wrong answer.
